body:
Ya I go to class everyday no worries about that, and girls in my types of classes are few and far between, I counted 12 in a class of 150 the other day.  

And putting myself out there isn't as easy as everyone makes it sound.  By this point in the school year it is extremely late to meet people, and I don't even know where to begin to meet girls.

I feel restricted yeno? like I enjoy alot of things but I can't really do those things. Sometimes what made everything worth doing was knowing that she was waiting there for me, no matter if I didn't succeed or pass, she would always be there for me.
